cards.title: Man-in-the-Middle (MITM)
cards.description_long: A Man-in-the-Middle attack occurs when an attacker secretly intercepts and possibly alters communication between two parties without their knowledge. This allows attackers to capture credentials, session tokens, or sensitive data.

main_commands.explanation: Attempt to downgrade HTTPS to HTTP

activity: Capture network traffic between hosts
Analyze packets for credentials or session tokens
Understand HTTPS vs HTTP security
Observe how encryption prevents interception
Learn detection and mitigation techniques

cards.title: ARP Spoofing
cards.description_short: Poison ARP tables to redirect traffic
cards.description_long: ARP spoofing (or ARP poisoning) involves sending fake ARP messages on a local network. This tricks devices into sending traffic to the attacker instead of the legitimate destination.

main_commands.explanation: Send fake ARP replies to victim
View ARP neighbor table in Linux

activity: View ARP table entries
Perform ARP spoofing in a lab environment
Observe traffic redirection effects
Capture packets after ARP poisoning
Understand defenses like static ARP entries

cards.title: DNS Spoofing
cards.description_long: DNS spoofing (or DNS cache poisoning) manipulates DNS responses to redirect users to malicious servers instead of legitimate websites. This can be used for phishing or malware delivery.

main_commands.explanation: Query DNS server for domain information
Perform DNS spoofing using Ettercap plugin

activity: Query DNS records using dig or nslookup
Observe DNS resolution process
Test DNS spoofing in a lab environment
Analyze DNS packets in Wireshark
Understand how DNSSEC helps prevent spoofing

cards.title: Ping Flood
cards.description_short: Overwhelm a system with ICMP requests
cards.description_long: A ping flood is a type of Denial-of-Service (DoS) attack where a large number of ICMP echo requests are sent to a target system to overwhelm its network resources and make it unavailable.

main_commands.explanation: Send ICMP echo request to target

activity: Send ICMP requests to a host
Observe ICMP packets in Wireshark
Understand how flood attacks overwhelm systems
Analyze network traffic during a flood test
Learn mitigation techniques like rate limiting
